svg.title: Dip Buyers Fondue Co. share certificate
svg.desc: A joke share certificate of DIP BUYERS FONDUE CO., printed in one ink with a red wax seal. The vignette shows a fondue pot over a small flame, with two long forks dipping bread into it. Under the name it says THIS CERTIFIES NOTHING, and a sheet of five numbered coupons hangs below a perforation.
